related_questions.question: What are the three types of strokes?

text_blocks.snippet: The three main types of strokes are ischemic, hemorrhagic, and transient ischemic attack (TIA). Ischemic strokes, the most common type, occur when a blood clot blocks an artery in the brain, preventing blood flow. Hemorrhagic strokes happen when a blood vessel in the brain ruptures and bleeds, putting pressure on brain tissue. TIAs, also known as "mini-strokes," are temporary interruptions of blood flow to the brain and are often a warning sign of a future stroke.
